summary: Tests-only run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Added two test files plus the plan/delta documentation. The vendored-document coverage tests run today and fail red (document not vendored yet, as expected in this phase); the generated-client tests are canImport-gated and were validated off-tree: all 19 tests pass against a real swift-openapi-generator 1.9.0 client built from docs/openapi-vendored-reference.json with swift-openapi-runtime 1.9.0 / swift-http-types 1.8.0. No Swift toolchain exists in the repo CI environment for this run's local suite; validation ran on Linux aarch64 Swift 6.0.3 off-tree.

acceptance_criteria.description: Add swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime to the iOS package; fetch or vendor the OpenAPI document from viamin/color_matching#110

verification.evidence: Fails red at PR head (expected in tests-only phase): iOS/Sources/OpenAPIGenerated/openapi.json does not exist, so all 12 OpenAPIDocumentCoverageTests fail with an actionable vendoring message. Off-tree validation with the reference document: all pass.

acceptance_criteria.description: Generate the client for the six app-used surfaces (manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results)

verification.evidence: Coverage tests pin path+verb+stable operationId+typed schemas for all six operations (red at head); GeneratedClientTests exercise all six generated methods against stubbed transports (validated off-tree: 7/7 pass against real generator output).

acceptance_criteria.description: Replace the app's hand-written API models with generated types; keep purely client-side models as-is

verification.evidence: Implementation-run work. The test contract is in place: GeneratedClientTests construct generated Components.Schemas payloads (CaptureRequest, MeasurementUploadRequest, JudgmentUploadRequest) and decode generated response types, so the rewiring lands against these tests. Client-side models (MeasurementCore geometry types) are documented to stay as-is.

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift tests exercising the generated client against local stubbed responses (no live server in CI)

verification.evidence: GeneratedClientTests uses StubTransport (a ClientTransport) returning canned JSON for all six operations plus a 404 case; zero network. Validated off-tree: 7/7 pass. At head the file compiles out (canImport gate) until the generated target exists.

acceptance_criteria.description: PR description records what changed between the prose contract and the published spec, and any endpoint gaps

verification.evidence: 16 numbered deltas with upstream file citations (api_schemas.ex, controllers, test_sheet_json.ex from viamin/color_matching@main after PR #113) recorded in docs/openapi-generated-client-plan.md §5, ready to be cited in the PR description of the implementation run. This run cannot open the final PR (tests-only draft).
